MADMAIL lets you host your own chat rela: MADMAIL lets you host your own chat relay, including on a local network. With accounts and the required relay, discovery, and notification paths configured locally, your communication can stay within that network.
That makes the combination useful beyond: That makes the combination useful beyond a public cloud setup. You control where the relay runs and how devices reach it; using the same Wi-Fi alone does not make public relay traffic local.
Encrypted, even through a public relay.
You can also use community-run chatmail: You can also use community-run chatmail relays, including the public provisioning route used by a default Sigma setup. In the normal encrypted contact flow, messages and app updates are end-to-end encrypted; the relay transports ciphertext rather than reading your conversation.
Relays store and forward messages so del: Relays store and forward messages so delivery can work when a device is offline. They remove messages after delivery or according to their retention policy, typically after a few weeks. Exact timing depends on the relay and device setup, rather than an instant-deletion guarantee.

Realtime webxdc apps use Iroh to connect: Realtime webxdc apps use Iroh to connect participants over encrypted peer-to-peer channels. Live events are ephemeral; apps can also send durable updates through chat so people who were offline can catch up.

Webxdc packages HTML, CSS, JavaScript, a: Webxdc packages HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets into a mini app. Its sandbox blocks ordinary internet access, so a static preview can run locally without a public URL or tracking requests. Shared updates go through the host messenger’s APIs; server-side features need adaptation.

Built on a resilient network of simple s: Built on a resilient network of simple store-and-forward relays. Proven protocols carry your messages; end-to-end encryption keeps their contents private.
Store-and-forward delivery lets people r: Store-and-forward delivery lets people receive messages after reconnecting. Chatmail relays focus on encrypted delivery, while previews run on your device. MADMAIL brings message delivery and encryption enforcement into a single server binary you can host. Resource needs depend on traffic, attachment sizes, and retention.
Your bot’s chat uses the same end-to-end: Your bot’s chat uses the same end-to-end encryption as your conversations with family and friends. Create separate chatmail profiles for yourself and your bots without providing a phone number or an existing email address. Independent relays keep you connected, even when you choose different servers.
